author: AgentPlatform
name: GitHub Copilot agent platform
description: A governed agent platform for one GitHub organization: managed settings, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP, standards, agents and agentic workflows, defined in F#.

org.description: GitHub organization that owns .github-private and the plugin marketplace.

enterprise.description: GitHub enterprise slug (leave empty if the organization is not in an enterprise).

host.description: HTTPS base URL of the platform service (hook decisions, OTLP collector, MCP registry).

company.description: Display name used in rendered instructions and READMEs.
